title: iris × germanica subsp. illyrica
intro: Iris × germanica subsp. illyrica, commonly known as the Dalmatian Iris or Illyrian Iris, is a subspecies of the German Iris, a flowering plant native to the Balkan Peninsula. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Iris × germanica subsp. illyrica include wound healing, skin protection, and antimicrobial activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. These constituents contribute to its potential therapeutic applications in treating various health conditions, including infections, skin diseases, and inflammation-related disorders.
